description: DUT handles an illegal MSS option length in a SYN without crashing (RFC 1122 §4.2.2.5 p85). Iterations: ilen=0 and ilen=5
approach:
[Objective]
The MSS option's legal length is 4 bytes (1 kind + 1 length + 2 mss). ilen=0 or ilen=5 is illegal. DUT must reject the option but not crash — likely defaulting MSS or dropping the SYN.

[Scenario — chronological]
Two iterations: tester sends SYN with MSS option of length 0 and length 5. DUT must either complete handshake (rejecting the option silently) or refuse the connection — but never crash.

[Pass condition]
DUT survives both phases (reaches ESTABLISHED OR sends a clean RST).

[Fail condition]
• Fail_not_established — no progress / crash
• Fail_timeout — no DUT SYN,ACK within listen window

verdicts.Pass: DUT survived illegal MSS length — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT SYN,ACK within listen window
